name: Shin Shin Co Ltd.
summary: Shin Shin Co Ltd. manages a network of department stores and subterranean shopping districts across Taiwan. These retail locations offer a diverse array of merchandise, encompassing fashion apparel, footwear, leather goods, and accessories for men and women, alongside beauty products, personal care items, and a broad selection of food and beverage options, such as bread, coffee, and specialty teas. Beyond its core retail operations, the company also oversees grocery stores, various dining establishments, and parking facilities. Shin Shin Co Ltd. was established in 1960 and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
